people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: But the thing displeased Samuel, when they said, “Give us a king to judge us.” Samuel prayed to Yahweh.
translations.bsb: But when they said, “Give us a king to judge us,” their demand was displeasing in the sight of Samuel; so he prayed to the LORD.
translations.kjv: But the thing displeased Samuel, when they said, Give us a king to judge us. And Samuel prayed unto the LORD.
translations.asv: But the thing displeased Samuel, when they said, Give us a king to judge us. And Samuel prayed unto Jehovah.
